bounded_finding.summary: NC-TFAD is a fresh task-free continual anomaly-detection formulation whose learner receives a single-pass stream of normal batches without task boundaries or identifiers and without historical samples; synthetic anomalous counterparts are generated from the current batch. The pretrained backbone is frozen, while a lightweight projection is trained against two fixed antipodal ETF directions shared across categories. The paper describes unified evaluation after training, so this leaf localizes the method's retention mechanism primarily to fixed backbone geometry plus projection regularization rather than backbone plasticity.
bounded_finding.scope_note: This slice does not audit reported quantitative tables or claim a metric inconsistency; it only establishes the fresh method/protocol from the primary artifact.
